message: Ready to buy today and pay in full. $31,000 for T45 with delivery.

Thanks for the offer, and I appreciate that you're ready to buy today. $31,000 is well below where we can go on the T45 with delivery. The list price for that package is $42,900. Since you're paying in full today, I can come down to $40,500 for the T45 Utility with delivery and on-site setup. That gets you 45 hp, 4WD, a Cat I/II 3-point hitch, and a 540 PTO, delivered and walked through at your place.
I have a competing option. $33,000 delivered and I'll pay right now.

I understand you're weighing options, and I want to earn your business today. $33,000 is still well under what we can do on this package. Since you're ready to pay in full right now, I'll come down to $39,200 for the T45 Utility with delivery, on-site setup, and a full walkthrough. That's a meaningful move from our $42,900 list. If the other option includes comparable delivery and setup, I'm happy to talk through how the packages compare.
My firm ceiling is $34,000. Tractor alone or with delivery, either works. Pay immediately.

I appreciate the straightforward number. I can't make $34,000 work on the T45, though. My best price on the T45 Utility tractor alone is $37,800, paid today. If $34,000 is a hard budget, there's another way to get there. The T25 Compact (25 hp, 4WD, hydrostatic) with the quick-attach front loader and delivery and setup comes in at $34,000. That fits well if your property is under about 10 acres. If you need the T45's 3-point hitch and PTO for brush hogging or tilling on more acreage, $37,800 is where I can go. Let me know which one suits you better.
Final offer: $34,300 for the T45 alone, paid now. The T25 is too small for 17 acres of brush hogging.

Thanks, that helps. For 17 acres of brush hogging, the T45 is the right machine, and the 540 PTO and Cat I/II hitch will handle that work well. I can't go as low as $34,300. I'll make one more move, though: $36,900 for the T45 Utility tractor alone, paid today. That's $5,100 off list, and it's the lowest I can go on this tractor.
